question: Does the fix stack chosen by diagnosis on one human demo (Pexels notebook cycle) transfer unchanged to other demos of the same person with different objects and motions?
demo_note: cycles of the same Pexels clip; grasp/release frames annotated by frame inspection (transfergap/demo/clips.py) after the notebook experiments; converted from the existing GEM-X joints; no re-tuning of anything
carry_scale_note: the human carry is short for two demos (4-5 cm vs 9 cm for the notebook), so the retargeter stretches the human carry ~7-8x onto the robot's ~34 cm carry; no exclusion rule is applied — the stretch factor is reported per demo
